description: Arranges clips into a screen layout by writing ordinary transform + crop values (first clipId → first cell). layout: full | side-by-side | top-bottom | pip-top-left | pip-top-right | pip-bottom-left | pip-bottom-right | grid-2x2 | main-sidebar | three-up. mode 'fit' letterboxes each source in its cell, 'cover' fills the cell and crops the overflow (bias 0–1 picks the surviving part; 0.5/0.5 = centre). Replaces the clips' geometry animation. The clips should overlap in time on different tracks — a layout of clips that never share a frame arranges nothing visible.

clipIds.description: Clips to arrange, in cell order.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: apply_layout
